# BlancoByte

BlancoByte builds private, secure database and analytics solutions. Everything runs inside your own network, on-premise or in your own cloud, so your data never leaves the boundaries you control.

## What we do
- Private, in-network analytics and reporting
- Database consulting: architecture, deployment, performance tuning, migration
- Real time insight, in plain language or SQL
